observations.title: Embedded file permission vs reference
observations.description: Uploaded files inherit page access; a link to a separately stored file does not itself grant access. Copied summaries on the page become visible to page readers.
observations.acceptance: Check view/edit roles, embedded files, external access and revoke behavior.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Personal vs shared artifact state
observations.description: Artifacts can store private per-user data or common shared data. First shared-storage use shows a confirmation. New artifacts can store before publishing; legacy artifacts require publication.
observations.acceptance: Test two accounts, save/reload and visibility; distinguish current and legacy artifacts.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Invitation expiry and revocation
observations.description: Pending email invitations expire in 30 days; accepted invitations do not expire automatically. Removing a person revokes access immediately. Organization settings and plan affect invitations.
observations.acceptance: Test pending, expired, accepted, revoked and disabled external sharing.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Artifact permission roles
observations.description: Viewer reads artifact/comments; commenter adds comments and downloads offered files; editor can change content. External commenters and editors have limitations; editors cannot delete artifact.
observations.acceptance: Test each role and artifact type, including disabled comments and connectors.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Library content facets and pinned items
observations.description: Desktop Library filters All, Pages, Media, Links, Files, Apps and Pinned. Team Bot separates private-to-user and bot files; pin treatment differs.
observations.acceptance: Test filter results, pin/unpin and private/team visibility.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Stable page address and rename
observations.description: Rename commits with Enter or cancels with Escape; a public page address remains unchanged after renaming. Custom addresses are not supported per guide.
observations.acceptance: Test cancel, rename, stable link and access revoke.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Sharing conflict and retry
observations.description: Share menu explains unavailable audiences, failed access changes and concurrent access updates; failed saves offer Retry.
observations.acceptance: Exercise conflict, failed request, retry and inaccessible audience; no silent success.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Copy shared Canvas content
observations.description: A public shared Canvas result can be copied into a user's own editable Canvas; shared app data is a separate concept. Copy/edit shared content requires age 18+, and links open in web.
observations.acceptance: Test new object identity, original unchanged, shared data boundary and mobile limitation.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Shared site with private inputs
observations.description: Every user of a shared site, including owner, sees only their own saved inputs. Site viewers require access to the full notebook; public sharing requires consumer owner/editor.
observations.acceptance: Test two users, saved selections, notebook permissions and no cross-user input leakage.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Site revocation and deletion
observations.description: Turning off site sharing or deleting the site invalidates previously generated share links; sites can also be downloaded from Studio.
observations.acceptance: Test old links, role checks, export and deletion confirmation.
observations.classification: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

correction.description: Artifact access can include view, comment or edit depending on role and type. Unpublishing a legacy artifact permanently deletes its stored data; do not generalize that rule to current artifacts.
